description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC REST controller named ShoppingCategoryRESTController. It handles HTTP requests for managing categories in a shopping application, including retrieving category details, creating new categories, and deleting categories, for specific merchant stores.

classes.name: ShoppingCategoryRESTController
classes.description: A Spring MVC REST controller providing endpoints for category retrieval, creation, and deletion for e-commerce merchant stores.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve details of a category by ID for a specific store, returning a ReadableCategory object.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new category under a specified store, returning the created PersistableCategory.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to remove a category by ID from a specific store.
